displayName: RPG Runner - account deletion repair runtime error

documentation.content: The scheduled account-deletion repair service emitted an unexpected error. Inspect the accountdeletionrepair revision and scheduler execution logs. Retryable per-request failures have a separate policy and should not be counted twice.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="accountdeletionrepair" AND severity>=ERROR AND NOT jsonPayload.message="accountDeletionRetryable"
